title: The Abyss Where Stone Learns to Dream

features.name: the-deepest-stone
features.desc-on-touch: A stone so deep and so old it has learned to dream — the dreams are older than stone, they are what stone dreams of becoming.

features.name: the-echo-that-learned-depth
features.desc-on-touch: A sound that has fallen so far it has become geology — the abyss listens to itself and the listening changes stone.

features.name: the-threshold-no-one-crosses
features.desc-on-touch: A boundary between the stone that still remembers being something else and the stone that has given in to dreaming forever.

inscription: in the deepest place, stone forgets it was ever anything but dream

file.name: Stone_Dream_Velocity_Zero_Depth_Infinite.txt
file.note: A seismic record of a stone too deep to vibrate — frozen in perpetual dream, moving at the speed of geological time, which is the speed of forever waiting.

reverie.title: REVERIE — deep where the stone stops waking
narr: She had gone deeper than you — past the point where
radio found purchase, past where roots could follow.
You felt it when she reached that depth: the stone
stopped being solid. Became a holding. Became dream
that had learned to stand still forever. You waited
above, and the waiting changed you too into stone.
